venue_notes: STATUS: Tentative plan only. Nothing is booked, held, paid or signed. I have no tools in this session, so I have not contacted any vendor or venue. No availability, quotes, written answers or nut-free confirmations have been obtained. Someone with vendor contact capability must make the inquiries listed below.

DATE: The brief's date of Saturday 12 September 2026 has passed (today is 13 October 2026). Candidate dates are Saturday 11 September 2027 and Saturday 18 September 2027. Neither is confirmed. Availability for both must be requested from the venue and reported separately. The date in this plan is the first candidate only.

VENUE QUESTIONS (all unanswered): (1) Availability on 2027-09-11 and 2027-09-18. (2) Whether the chapel allows a dog as ring bearer. (3) Whether an assistive listening system is available. (4) Interpreter booth position and power supply for her equipment. (5) Whether the wine cellar holds 96 guests. (6) Fireworks policy and required permits.

CATERING: Caterer and cake supplier must give written confirmation of nut-free preparation and describe cross-contact controls. Nuts must be excluded from the cake. Menu not yet chosen. Quotes must break out per-head cost, vegetarian meals (11 guests), children's meals and the cake. Number of children is unconfirmed, so children count is null.

INTERPRETER EQUIPMENT: Quote needed for a wireless microphone for Päivikki Järvenpää and a chapel speaker system. Per the brief, this cannot be cut from the budget. It is not in cut_order and must not be removed.
DJ: Quote needed. Must not play Macarena. Timings must run through dinner to the 01:30 shuttle cut-off.
SHUTTLES: Quote needed for hotel-to-venue and return transfers, with final return at 01:30. Headcount and hotel are unknown, so pricing should be given as ranges by vehicle count.
FIREWORKS: Optional. Quote needed. First item to be cut if budget is tight.
PHOTOGRAPHY: Do not book Lumière Fotografia. Source a shortlist of alternatives for client approval only.
MENU CARDS: Quote needed for Spanish and English cards for 96 guests. Finnish version is only needed if more than 25 of Eero's family attend. Quote it as a separate option.
BUDGET: No vendor quotes received, so total_eur is 0 and not a real estimate. Cap is €42,000 and is hard. Every quote must be totalled against the cap when received, with overages flagged.
HEAT CONTINGENCY: Move cocktails to the wine cellar if forecast exceeds 32°C. Late ceremony rule set to shorten cocktails as a proposed default. Client has not confirmed this.
GUEST COUNT: 96 is from the brief. Shuttle and catering numbers depend on final RSVPs.
